decisions.plainLanguageQuestion: Should Communication inbox (/messages) and CRM outreach (/crm/messages) stay as two separate business functions, or be collapsed?
decisions.recommendedLabel: Keep both as separate canonical business functions

rejectedOptions.label: Make /messages an alias of /crm/messages
rejectedOptions.reason: Functional and RBAC equivalence NOT proven

rejectedOptions.label: Retire one function and migrate its capability in Phase 4
rejectedOptions.reason: CRM retirement needs a durable CRM migration program outside Phase 4 nav cutover; retiring COMMS would destroy certified messaging

decisions.consequence: Revise Phase 1 B01: do NOT redirect /messages→/crm/messages. Restore /messages as canonical Communication route in registry/menu/search (with proper COMMS auth). Keep /crm/messages as canonical CRM outreach.
decisions.risk: Canonical registry currently treats CRM as sole messaging owner; revising B01 requires registry + menu updates and clear labels so users do not confuse inbox vs outreach.
decisions.implementationImpact: No alias redirect. Update ownerDecisions/catalog/menu/search; add COMMS route permissions if missing; keep both pages mounted.

decisions.plainLanguageQuestion: Approve retaining all 42 unmapped /tournament/* routes with zero invented redirects until semantic successors exist?
decisions.recommendedLabel: Retain all 42; no redirects; writer hygiene only where links already have a tournamentId and a proven same-workflow target

rejectedOptions.label: Redirect hubs/setup to Engine tabs
rejectedOptions.reason: Semantic mapping unproven; would break daily/internal/official/team/register/public/director flows

rejectedOptions.label: Invent or guess tournamentId for hub redirects

decisions.consequence: Phase 4 implements no B02 redirects. Legacy mounts remain for compatibility. Flag ON menu/search continue excluding /tournament/*.
decisions.risk: Legacy deep links and flag-OFF writers remain until a later incremental migration program.
decisions.implementationImpact: Docs matrix only for redirects; optional replace_link_writer for Engine breadcrumb/back away from legacy /tournament after OD-PLURAL approved.

decisions.plainLanguageQuestion: Who may open /player/skill-assessment-v5 by direct URL: SUPER_ADMIN only (Phase 1 B03 text), or enrolled PLAYER pilots under the V5 product contract?
decisions.recommendedLabel: Hide from all menus/search; allow authenticated SUPER_ADMIN always for tech eval; allow PLAYER only when VITE_PICK_VN_RATING_V5_ENABLED + active pilot enrollment; deny all others with 403; flag alone never exposes menu

rejectedOptions.label: Router SUPER_ADMIN-only for all direct access
rejectedOptions.reason: Conflicts with V5 foundation PLAYER self-assessment pilot RPCs and existing page access service

rejectedOptions.label: Authenticated-only route + PLAYER menu when flag on
rejectedOptions.reason: Violates B03 hide-shadow menu rule and over-exposes via legacy menu writers

decisions.consequence: Revises B03 direct-access wording from SUPER_ADMIN-only to pilot-aligned shadow. Menu/search remain hidden in every shell.
decisions.risk: If Owner insists on strict SUPER_ADMIN-only, Rating V5 pilot UX breaks until a separate PLAYER entry is provided.
decisions.implementationImpact: Change authGuard/menuAccess/navigationConfig (remove PLAYER menu leaf); keep page-level resolveRatingV5Access; add denial tests; no redirect.

decisions.plainLanguageQuestion: Should /tournaments/:tournamentId/* Engine routes require authentication and tournament permissions at least as strong as legacy /tournament/* before Preview flag ON?
decisions.recommendedLabel: Remove plural routes from public-auth prefix descendants; require auth; route-level permission tournament.update (matching page gate) or documented split; add tenant/club ownership check before engine load

rejectedOptions.label: Keep /tournaments/* public-auth
rejectedOptions.reason: Weaker than legacy; exposes engine deep links when auth production enabled

rejectedOptions.label: Only require tournament.view
rejectedOptions.reason: Weaker than current page PermissionGate tournament.update for mutating tabs

decisions.consequence: Closes Preview blocker BLK-PLURAL-AUTHZ. Public catalog /tournaments (list) remains public; parameterized Engine family becomes protected.
decisions.risk: Deep links that previously worked anonymously will require login — intentional hardening.
decisions.implementationImpact: authGuard.js PUBLIC_PATH_PREFIXES refinement; menuAccess.js plural matcher; optional ownership assert in useTournamentEngine/RouteAccessGate; tests in phase4-tournament-authz.

instructions: Owner must approve or revise each OD-* before Phase 4 runtime implementation. Selecting B for OD-B01 requires proving functional+RBAC equivalence (currently NO).
